newsitem.title: CHINA: China says all Xinjiang plots doomed to fail.
newsitem.headline: China says all Xinjiang plots doomed to fail.

text.p: A senior Chinese military official has said all plots aimed at causing chaos in the restive northwestern area of Xinjiang were doomed to fail, the People's Daily reported on Tuesday.

During a visit to the mostly Moslem Xinjiang region this week, Zhang Zhen, vice-chairman of the powerful Central Military Commission, urged greater unity between the army and Xinjiang's people, many of whom are ethnic minorities, the newspaper said.

"If the unity between the army and peoples of all ethnicities is like a rock, then...any current or developing plots aimed at disrupting the stability of Xinjiang will be doomed to failure," the newspaper quoted Zhang as saying.
Xinjiang's present social stability and economic progress were a result of several generations of strong cooperation between the region's nationalities and the army, Zhang said.
Xinjiang has been rocked in recent months by sometimes violent clashes between Moslem separatists and Chinese authorities and by politically motivated assassination attempts.
Premier Li Peng last week warned religious worshippers in Xinjiang not to step out of line and called for tighter controls on religious activities.
